description: This Java source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates various techniques for animating multiple properties of views in parallel, including ValueAnimator, ViewPropertyAnimator, ObjectAnimator, and PropertyValuesHolder.

classes.name: MultiPropertyAnimations
classes.description: An Android activity class demonstrating multiple property animation techniques.

methods.name: runValueAnimator
methods.description: Animates the translation X and Y properties of a view using a ValueAnimator and an update listener.

methods.name: runViewPropertyAnimator
methods.description: Animates view properties such as translationX and translationY using the ViewPropertyAnimator API.

methods.name: runObjectAnimators
methods.description: Runs separate ObjectAnimator instances for translation X and Y properties, potentially in parallel.

methods.name: runObjectAnimator
methods.description: Uses PropertyValuesHolder to animate multiple properties with a single ObjectAnimator instance.
